annotations.title: What a wallet did (transfer by transfer)

description: Every token transfer in or out of a wallet over the last hours, newest first, across Robinhood Chain, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, HyperEVM and Elysium: time, chain, in or out, token, amount, USD at today's prices, the counterparty, and a link to the transaction. Free, for a one-off look at any wallet. To keep a list of wallets with private names and get what changed since you last checked, use the paid watch_wallet and watched_events.

hours.description: How far back, default 24, max 168 (a week)
